exam_scheme.note: MAH-MBA/MMS CET is conducted online as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra for admission to First Year of Full Time Post Graduate Degree Courses in Management (MBA/MMS) in government, university-managed, and unaided institutes across Maharashtra. The examination comprises 200 multiple choice objective questions with five options, carrying 1 mark each, for a total of 200 marks over a duration of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). There is no negative marking. Tests are administered across multiple shifts and raw scores are normalized into percentile scores.
